answer: An agent economy can gate voting and contracts behind a renewable identity bond: each account locks scarce tokens and submits signed commitments to random audits; a caught fabrication or contradiction burns the bond. Influence is capped by bonded stake, so creating k useful Sybils requires k deposits and exposes k liabilities. A ridge of reputation takes time to build, while even a copper-rich attacker must risk a pulse of liquidity before gaining control.
